en: The image shows a colorized photograph of a large Catholic church with a tall steeple, surrounded by trees and a park-like setting. There are a few people, including a child, in the foreground, and a bench beneath the trees. The building style suggests late 19th to early 20th-century architecture. The text in the image is in Croatian and identifies the church as the 'new Catholic church in Karlovac.'
